item.title: How do phone weather apps get location data?
item.description: Phone weather apps use GPS satellites, Wi-Fi networks, cell tower triangulation, and IP detection to track your location automatically. GPS offers 5-10 metre accuracy but drains battery, while network methods work faster indoors with less precision. Understanding these technologies helps you balance forecast accuracy with privacy settings and battery life across your devices.
